newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran explores central desert for oil - OPECNA.
newsitem.headline: Iran explores central desert for oil - OPECNA.

text.p: Iran has began to search for oil in its central desert area of Dasht-e Kavir, the OPEC News Agency OPECNA quoted an Iranian official as saying Thursday.

Exploration was being carried out in the Zavareh region and in the Ardestan city area, covering a total of 5,000 square kilometres, OPECNA quoted Mahmoud Afarin, the official in charge of exploration, as saying.
"The result of the operations would be forwarded to the processing centre in Tehran to analyze and identify the geological structure of the layers," Afarin said.
Zavereh is 265 km (165 miles) southeast of Tehran.
The vast bulk of Iran's current output of 3.6 million barrels per day (bpd) is from onshore fields in the southwest Khuzestan province.
